h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Solapur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Solapur

items.pText: Keeping a lawn green through a Solapur summer takes a lot of water, and the patch under a swing or slide rarely survives it. That is why most play areas here end up on dusty, hard ground. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment and rubber flooring to schools, housing societies and gardens in Solapur, made at our factory in Vasai East, about 370 km away.

Solapur, in the south-east of Maharashtra, is known for its textile mills, its chaddars and towels, and the Siddheshwar temple by the lake. The climate is hot and dry, and the monsoon is lighter than on the coast. Tell us how big the site is and who will use it, and attach a few photos. We will recommend equipment and flooring together, on a drawing that shows the safe play area.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: A play surface that does not need watering

c: Rubber flooring needs no water at all, and it cushions falls far better than hard, dry soil. Lay it on a compacted, level base with a slight slope, so the occasional heavy shower drains off. Sweep it every few days to remove dust and leaves.

Around the play area, use paving or hardy plants that need little water, and keep any lawn outside the safe play area. Solapur's afternoons are very hot from March to May, so place slides where a building or tree shades them, and choose lighter colours for seats and decks. For a Maharashtra project, see

items.q: What surface should we use under play equipment in a dry city?
items.a: Rubber flooring on a compacted base. It needs no watering, cushions falls and is easy to sweep clean. We supply it along with the equipment.

items.q: How do we keep slides cool in Solapur's summer?
items.a: Place them in the shade of a building or tree, turn them away from the afternoon sun and choose lighter colours for the surfaces children touch.
Yes. We deliver by road from our Vasai factory, about 370 km away, and install through our own team or a local dealer.
